messages.subject: No rstan for R 3.2.1?
parts:
Hi all

I just upgraded to the newest R version and tried to install rstan from CRAN. However, I get the following message:

> R.Version()
$platform
[1] "x86_64-apple-darwin13.4.0"

$arch
[1] "x86_64"

$os
[1] "darwin13.4.0"

$system
[1] "x86_64, darwin13.4.0"

$status
[1] ""

$major
[1] "3"

$minor
[1] "2.1"

$year
[1] "2015"

$month
[1] "06"

$day
[1] "18"

$`svn rev`
[1] "68531"

$language
[1] "R"

$version.string
[1] "R version 3.2.1 (2015-06-18)"

$nickname
[1] "World-Famous Astronaut"

> install.packages('rstan')
Warning message:
package ‘rstan’ is not available (for R version 3.2.1)
>
